headline.en: UNI holds above treasury anchor at $7.32 but net inflation persists at +1.87%/year with no catalyst in sight
headline.zh: UNI 守住国库锚定价 $7.32，但年化净通胀率仍达 +1.87%，且缺乏催化剂

keyChanges.en: Net emission remains +16.54M UNI/year as annualized burns (3.46M) cover only 17% of fixed 20M annual issuance
keyChanges.zh: 年化净增发 +1654 万枚 UNI，回购销毁(346 万枚)仅覆盖固定 2000 万枚年发行量的 17%

keyChanges.en: TVL declined -5.61% to $3.56B over 7 days while price gained +3.26%, signaling capital flight amid speculative positioning
keyChanges.zh: 7 日内 TVL 下跌 -5.61% 至 35.6 亿美元，而币价上涨 +3.26%，显示资金外流与投机性持仓并存

keyChanges.en: Long/short account ratio at 1.97 shows retail crowding the long side with $47.6M open interest and +0.01% funding
keyChanges.zh: 多空账户比 1.97 显示散户扎堆做多，持仓量 4760 万美元，资金费率 +0.01%

contrarianObservation.en: Price holding $7+ despite ongoing dilution and zero governance progress suggests sophisticated accumulation; market may be front-running a Q1 2026 real-yield proposal that insiders expect to pass, which would convert $148M annualized revenue into ~7.4% staking yield at 100M UNI staked
contrarianObservation.zh: 尽管持续增发且治理无进展，币价仍守住 $7 以上或暗示机构吸筹；市场可能提前布局 2026 年 Q1 真实收益提案(内部预期通过)，届时 1.489 亿美元年化收益可转化为约 7.4% 质押收益率(按 1 亿枚质押计)

watchNext.en: Any RFC advancement on real-yield staking distribution—this is the only catalyst that shifts UNI from reflexive to DCF valuation
watchNext.zh: 真实收益质押分配 RFC 的任何推进——这是唯一能让 UNI 从反射性估值转向现金流贴现估值的催化剂

watchNext.en: Net emission crossover threshold: if UNI drops to ~$4, burn rate would exceed issuance and flip the inflation narrative
watchNext.zh: 净增发交叉点阈值：若 UNI 跌至约 $4，销毁率将超过增发率并扭转通胀叙事

watchNext.en: TVL trend persistence—another -5% weekly decline would confirm capital flight and invalidate the accumulation thesis
watchNext.zh: TVL 趋势延续性——若再出现周跌 -5%，将确认资金外流并否定吸筹假设

fullReasoning.en: UNI trades in a narrow equilibrium where modest price strength (+3.26% weekly to $7.32) collides with structural inflation headwinds. The core problem remains unresolved: despite the buyback-and-burn narrative, UNI dilutes holders by 1.87% annually because 20M token issuance vastly exceeds the 3.46M annualized burn rate at current prices. This gap won't close unless price collapses to $4 or protocol revenue quintuples. The divergence between declining TVL (-5.61% to $3.56B) and rising price suggests retail speculation rather than fundamental demand, especially with volume anemic at $19M/24h. Yet price holds firmly above the $5.96 treasury burn anchor—the DAO's own fair-value mark—and derivatives show no panic (neutral funding, moderate OI). The long/short ratio of 1.97 indicates retail crowding but isn't extreme. The market appears frozen, waiting for the real-yield staking RFC to advance through governance. Without that catalyst, UNI remains a reflexive governance token oscillating in a range, not a cash-flow asset worth aggressive positioning. Current premium to treasury anchor lacks fundamental justification but hasn't collapsed either—hence neutral stance until governance breaks the deadlock or TVL decline accelerates.
fullReasoning.zh: UNI 处于狭窄均衡中，适度价格强势(周涨 +3.26% 至 $7.32)与结构性通胀阻力对冲。核心问题未解：尽管回购销毁叙事盛行，UNI 仍以年化 1.87% 稀释持币者，因 2000 万枚固定增发远超当前价格下 346 万枚的年化销毁量。除非币价崩至 $4 或协议收入暴增 5 倍，否则缺口无法弥合。TVL 下跌(-5.61% 至 35.6 亿美元)与币价上涨背离，显示散户投机而非基本面需求，尤其日交易量仅 1900 万美元的贫弱表现。然而价格稳守 $5.96 国库销毁锚定价(DAO 自身标记的公允价值)，衍生品未见恐慌(资金费率中性、持仓量适中)。多空账户比 1.97 显示散户扎堆但非极端。市场似乎冻结，等待真实收益质押 RFC 在治理中推进。缺乏该催化剂，UNI 仍是在区间震荡的反射性治理代币，而非值得激进布局的现金流资产。当前对国库锚定价的溢价缺乏基本面支撑，但也未崩溃——因此维持中性立场，直到治理打破僵局或 TVL 下跌加速。
